<!-- Tip: Use /create-skill in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

define a graphql api with a maximum of 5 nodes. For each node, provide the following details:

- Node name (e.g., User, Product)
- Node type (e.g., Object, Interface, Union)
- Fields with their types (e.g., id: ID!, name: String)
